name: @caistech/deal-model
description: Generic Estate Deal Model (F2K), V7 — the canonical, pure calculation engine that turns an ingested feasibility study into a base price, uplift split and GO/ADJUST/REJECT verdict. V7 recovers every party's contribution in the base. Single source of truth consumed by DealFindrs (compute) and F2K-Checkpoint/F2K-Projects (read).
